capabilities.library.albums.manage: Current owner of selected active library. Explicit album ownership, selected-asset scope, revision-bound edits, atomic audit. No publication or media deletion.
capabilities.library.people.manage: Current approved owner in the selected active library. Scoped people review, audited revision-bound rename and single-face assignment between exclusively scoped people. Invalidates affected person aggregates without vector/file writes. No merge, propagation, original-byte or job grant.
capabilities.story.write: Current contributor or owner membership. Contributors edit only their own stories; owners may moderate. Parent and child library scope, atomic revision checks, idempotent saves, CSRF for cookies. No AI caption or TV publication grant.
capabilities.public.ui: Anonymous, code-only UI shell/assets/redirects; never embedded library data. Redirect parameters are untrusted and may contain private search text.
capabilities.library.read: Verified principal plus current approved membership in the selected library. Viewer/contributor/owner; system operator has no implicit membership.
capabilities.media.original.read: Separate explicit original-byte grant AND library.read, including inline preview, download=true and every Range/conditional retry. Role alone is insufficient.
capabilities.library.curate: Approved membership with explicit curation grant; contributor/owner only in a later reviewed phase, never viewer.
capabilities.library.destroy: Approved owner with explicit destructive-action policy and argument-bound confirmation; deny in initial read-only release.
capabilities.library.upload: SUPERSEDED by upload.submit for the incoming-folder design: the upload is a pre-library action, so a library-scoped grant cannot express it. Retained because a future library-scoped upload (contributing straight into one library) would need it, and it remains disabled everywhere. Approved membership with separately granted upload capability; scope dedup before revealing IDs.
capabilities.system.read: Explicit system operator authority; family ownership alone does not grant diagnostics. Redact photo content unless separately authorized.
capabilities.system.jobs: Explicit system operator authority for jobs/configuration/ingest; bind any data access to an audited library scope, not implicit browse.
capabilities.service.invoke: Internal authenticated service identity, bounded resource admission and authorized job context. Not a public/mobile API.
capabilities.voice.read: library.read plus voice use grant and resource/privacy admission; scope every intent/result before providers, not caller client_id.
capabilities.voice.conversation: voice.read plus server-owned account/library/session conversation mapping; caller-supplied provider IDs are not authority.
capabilities.voice.command.dispatch: Dispatch-specific requirements: reads need voice.read; status needs system.read; mutations need their domain capability plus mandatory principal/session/library/argument-bound single-use confirmation. Disable mutations in v1.
capabilities.account.login: Phone/password authentication after durable source/account/global admission. No photo grant; current membership is checked separately.
capabilities.account.register.invited: Valid single-use owner-issued phone-bound invitation plus password, after shared login/registration admission. No first-signup owner.
capabilities.account.self: Current active account/session for own profile; logout is idempotent even after expiry. Cookie mutations require same-origin CSRF; native bearer is explicit.
capabilities.account.invitation.accept: Current active account/session plus matching unused owner invitation. Cannot reset a password or override newer membership decisions.
capabilities.library.members.manage: Current approved owner membership in the selected active library, distinct from system operator and original-byte permissions.
capabilities.home.discovery.read: Anonymous reviewed metadata discovery on the explicit home LAN, bound to the exact visible v2 catalog snapshot; reviewed person assignments and coarse regions only, provenance-aware tags, no live DB/model/legacy/biometric or raw GPS access.
capabilities.home.catalog.read: Deliberately anonymous full visible-catalog TV publication. Explicit LAN peer admission; prepared JPEG/MP4 only, no account, original, live DB, operator or public-ingress grant.
capabilities.home.feed.read: Deliberately anonymous selected home feed. Any reachable client in the explicit LAN peer allowlist can read published metadata and prepared derivatives; no account, pairing, original or operator grant.
capabilities.home.originals.read: Explicit v3 home LAN selected-source policy, pinned to the published catalog. Raw bytes require launcher allow-originals; never authorizes phone or arbitrary filesystem access.
capabilities.home.calendar.read: Explicit calendar metadata and existing cover descriptors for the same pinned Home snapshot; no new media, identity or audience grant.
capabilities.home.discovery.tags.read: Anonymous tag-name lookup over an explicitly pinned v2 metadata index, same reviewed Home media publication and actual LAN audience. No new media or identity grant.
capabilities.home.discovery.delivery.read: Anonymous reviewed discovery for the exact Home catalog and source index, preserving v3 media capabilities; no identity inference, account grant or live database access.
capabilities.upload.submit: Verified principal holding at least one approved, unexpired membership in an active library. Account-scoped, not library-scoped: the upload selects no library, and the photo is invisible to every member until an operator promotes and assigns it.
capabilities.caption.write: Any approved membership in the selected library. Deliberately not contributor-or-owner: an invitation creates a viewer and no route changes a role, so a contributor-gated write could never be reached. Matches the upload decision. Only where the asset has no current caption, so this cannot take a description away.
capabilities.upload.review: Explicit enabled runtime AND current operator and approved owner of selected active library. Pending upload must belong to a current approved member of this library. Sealed single-photo approval moves bytes and maps the asset atomically; no TV publication or job control.

routes.gap: Source/synthetic evidence only; the member control now exists in the protected page, so this is reachable, but no physical acceptance.
